title: Find your trail — visual comparison and interest filters

authorization.context: Founder approved five visual trail comparisons, interest choices, practical planning cues, linked story/save/book flow and placing the comparison before the long featured story.

scope: Five photographed choices: Stone, sea and makers; Chilika; Cuttack; Balasore; Mayurbhanj.
Heritage, nature, food, crafts and literature filters narrow only the comparison. All links remain readable without JavaScript.
Consistent starting-area, travel, timing and arrangement cues drawn from the existing five trail records.
Canonical story titles, URLs and photographs reused; existing starter buttons and saved journeys unchanged.
Shareable interest URLs preserve other parameters and fragments; Back, reset, unknown values and blocked history changes handled.
UTP design-pattern learning recorded; no shared-package version or wider adoption claimed.
research_boundary: No new external research; editorial synthesis of existing trail guidance. Each comparison stores its source trail path. Dated source notes remain available in the linked stories.

new_checks: Five comparisons precede the long story and resolve to story pages and starter controls
All cards remain visible in server-rendered HTML without scripting
Photographs and closing creator/licence credits resolve
Expected nature, crafts and literary filtering without mutating comparison data
URL initialisation, reset and Back synchronise pressed controls and results
Unknown query values fall back to all trails
Filtering remains functional when history writes fail
Controller cannot access local journey storage
Public comparison uses the same journey payload as story pages and My journey
validation.search_boundary: The approved eleven-route shortlist is unchanged; Journey Starters remains held from indexing.

limitations: No new rendered-browser, interactive browser, screen-reader, physical-device or native PDF pass. The prior administrator-enforced browser security-policy verification block remains unresolved.
Planning cues reuse existing trail research. No new local confirmation, transfer-time estimate, accessibility rating or current service availability is claimed.
Search Console processing was not rechecked.
next_action: Founder reviews the five-trail comparison candidate before merge and publication; rendered visual and assistive-technology checks remain separately open.
